summary: Session 2 of 2 (final) closed the set. (1) Regenerated the committed reports-baseline/ golden corpus for both fixtures via a new guarded GoldenCorpusRegenerator dev tool (AH_REGEN_GOLDEN env + Skip.IfNot) that reuses the exact GoldenNormalizer the gate uses, so each aggregates.json now carries DisplayTotals + the updated ContractNote: rptInvoice computes txtSubTotal=Sum((1-[Discount])*[Quantity]*[UnitPrice])=50313.622 with txtShipping/txtTotal (DisplayTotalNonAggregate) and txtTax (DisplayTotalUnsupportedFunction, IIf) honestly recorded in Skipped; rptTotalsByOwner/rptTotalsByCategory compute GrandTotalSum=Sum([OrderTotal]) with group-footer controls Skipped; the two HHC sub-reports get empty DisplayTotals. CanonicalGoldenRegressionTests passes 2/2 byte-for-byte against the regenerated corpus (no new normalization needed). (2) Wired the optional --include-pdf visual spot-check into a SEPARATE, non-gated reports-baseline-spot-check/ sibling (Option A, chosen by unanimous cross-provider consensus of gpt-5-4 + gemini-pro): the gated baseline-manifest.json stays PDF-free, a new SpotCheckManifest/SpotCheckManifestWriter indexes the PDFs, the gated corpus is byte-identical with/without --include-pdf, and a PDF render failure is non-blocking (recorded only on the spot-check manifest, never changing the report's gated status). ReportBaselineRunner.Run gained a spotCheckRoot parameter plus a PathsOverlap disjointness guard so a direct caller cannot place PDFs inside the gated tree. (3) Updated both fixture READ-ME-FIRST.md, interpretation-guide section 5.2, and the ROADMAP. Validation: solution builds clean; AccessHarvester.Tests 583 passed / 0 failed / 2 skipped (incl. the COM spot-check integration test PASSED); the rewritten hermetic ReportBaselineRunnerTests 18/18; 8 other hermetic projects green (1,747 tests). Two AccessHarvester.Integration COM tests failed as pre-existing known-flaky timeouts UNRELATED to this session's scope (classify-against-HomeHealthCare 240s timeout — the documented next-up spike — and sanitize-against-HomeHealthCare, which PASSED on a targeted retry confirming a one-off flake). Cross-provider verification (gpt-5-4): R1 ISSUES_FOUND with two Minor findings (unhardened spotCheckRoot/reportsBaselineRoot disjointness at the API boundary; a missing includePdf+ReadSpecFailed spot-check test); both fixed (added PathsOverlap guard + 3 new tests) and R2 returned VERIFIED. Targets release v1.2.0.
